_about: Expected v0.2.0 values on the 26 FlightKeys fixtures, taken from the release text by a separate, simpler extraction (one pattern per field) and checked against the field map v1.1 counts. No crew names, employee numbers or dates: crew values are in the private fixtures repo (expected/ofp-flightkeys-v0.2.0/crew.json). Free text (MEL titles, remarks, permit block) only as SHA-256.
